answer_1.quote: This work proposes X-CoT, an explainable framework that exchanges traditional cosine similarity-based ranking with LLM-based judgment and devises a chain-of-thought pipeline for text-video retrieval.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include ranked video candidates and natural language explanations justifying the rankings, generated via LLM-based chain-of-thought reasoning.

answer_2.quote: We report Recall@K (R@1, R@5, R@10), Median Rank (MdR), and Mean Rank (MnR).

answer_3.quote: We adopt LLM to process each tuple, yielding the binary preference (e.g., v_i < v_j) and the text justification.
